messages.subject: factanal()
parts:
Hey,

I'm using the factanal function and I am trying to get the factor
scores as part of the output. My code is:

factanal(data, factors=3, covmat=data.cormat, rotation="varimax",
scores="regression"),

where "data" is the original data and "data.cormat" is the correlation
matrix of the data. I'm getting an error that says, "requested scores
without an 'x' matrix." I thought that 'x' matrix is the original
data that are used with the loadings to equate the scores. The R help
section for this function is not very helpful.

Thanks,

Matty
